metadata.description: A Claude-maintained workspace for people who don't code.

plugins.name: onboarding
plugins.description: Sets up a Windows, macOS or Linux machine from scratch: apps, sign-ins, a private workspace on GitHub, and a help line. Run once.

plugins.name: guards
plugins.description: Safety hooks for every workspace: blocks risky git commands and secret files, and backs work up to GitHub at the end of each session.

plugins.name: explore
plugins.description: Turns 'I want to explore X' into a plain-English packet that can graduate into a goal.

plugins.name: unslop
plugins.description: Removes AI writing tells from everything a person reads.

plugins.name: helper
plugins.description: Help path: writes a help request, and turns the helper's remote access on or off.

plugins.name: pokeseller
plugins.description: Card-resale helpers: filling Mercari listings in Chrome and checking drafts against the folder's listing rules.

plugins.name: job-hunt
plugins.description: The morning job-hunt routine: find new postings, tailor a resume copy, update the tracker.
